$comment: Cover-sheet spec only. The component inventory — ids, sections, groups, captions and variants — lives next to the @Previews as @CatalogGroup / @CatalogComponent / @CatalogVariant annotations under catalog/src/main/kotlin/ee/schimke/a2uicatalog/sections/, and CatalogInventoryTest holds it to the eighteen components of the A2UI basic catalog v0.9.1. `referenceKits` names the Material 3 Design Kit because `material3-a2ui` draws the basic catalog with Material 3 components: a Card is an OutlinedCard, Tabs a PrimaryTabRow, a primary Button a filled Button, so the kit node for that Material component is the right comparison. Components the kit has no node for (layout, media, text roles) say so with `noReference`. There is no `compareWith` against m3-catalog: this sheet is rasterised by Robolectric while m3-catalog is rasterised by Skiko, and pairing the two would put a renderer difference into a comparison meant to be about the catalog.
title: A2UI basic catalog (Material 3)
